references.text: The original instruction to gather oil for the lampstand, anointing oil, and fragrant spices for the incense.
The recipe for the holy anointing oil mentioned in the verse.
The recipe for the fragrant incense (קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים) mentioned here.
The command regarding pure olive oil for the lampstand (מָאוֹר) in the tabernacle.
Describes the actual preparation of the anointing oil and incense, for which the materials in 35:28 were used.
Mentions the anointing oil and the fragrant incense among the finished items of the tabernacle.
Refers to the pure oil that was to be used to keep the lamps burning continuously.
Theological continuity: The same holy materials are used in the temple service.
Theological contrast: The same materials that were holy gifts in Exodus become symbolic secular trade.
